units: <cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 11:8">Targ. O. Num. XI, 8</cite> (h. text <he>פרור</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Micah 3:3">Targ. Mic. III, 3</cite> (h. text <cite ref="S01306"><he>קלחת</he></cite>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Joel 2:6">Targ. Joel II, 6</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 8:21">Targ. Jer. VIII, 21</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="A01752"><he>אִכְרוּם</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19">Lev. R. s. 19</cite>, beg. <he>יהבינון בקי׳ חדתא</he> he put them (the young ravens) into a new pot.

<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 7:10">Esth. R. to III, 6</cite> (prov.) <he>נפלה כיפה ק׳ ווי לק׳ וכ׳</he> if the stone falls on the pot, woe to the pot; if the pot falls on the stone, woe to the pot; (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 1054:7">Yalk. Esth. 1054</cite> <he>נפל קופה לקדרה וכ׳</he>).
Erub. 3ᵃ, a. e. ק׳ דשותפי, v. חַמִּים; a. fr.—Trnsf. intestines, rectum, bladder.
<cite ref="Berakhot 62b:2">Ber. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>עד דרתחא קִדְרָךְ וכ׳</he> while thy pot is hot, empty it (do not delay discharge).

<cite ref="Shabbat 33a:12">Sabb. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>נפישי קטילי קדר וכ׳</he> more numerous are those killed by the pot (by delay of discharge) than those killed by starvation.—[<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7">Num. R. s. 7</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 18">Lev. R. s. 18</cite> <he>לקדרא</he> some ed., v. <cite ref="S01900"><he>קַרְדָּא</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>קִדְרִין</he>, <he>קִדְרַיָּא</he>, <cite ref="S00089"><he>קִי׳</he></cite>, <cite ref="S00145"><he>קְדֵירָתָא</he></cite>.
